Introduction

Lee Sang Gon is a South Korean singer and songwriter. He is best known for being the leader and vocalist of the band Noel. On November 8, 2019, it was revealed that he would be getting married on March 24, 2020, to his girlfriend, actress Yeon Song Ha.
